parameters.name: CheckIds
parameters.description: The list of check item IDs.

parameters.name: CheckItemFuzzy
parameters.description: The check item name for fuzzy match.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page when using paging. The value starts from 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type for requests and responses. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page when using paging.

parameters.name: RecordIds
parameters.description: The list of whitelist record IDs.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
The data source. If this parameter is left empty, host data is queried by default. Valid values:
- **default**: host
- **agentless**: agentless.
